aboutMe: Mobile engineer, 4+ years across native iOS and Android, Flutter and React Native — from a 20-developer product team to sole ownership of apps built from scratch.
Performance and architecture ownership: cut an app from 200MB to 90MB, lifted key screens from 30–40 to a steady 60 FPS, migrated state management from Stream to BLoC.
Based in Ho Chi Minh City, with three years of remote delivery for a client in Japan.

groups.title: Real Estate Product – Flutter
groups.meta: Flutter, Clean Architecture, Scrum, Kanban · Team size: 20 mobile devs
bullets: Deliver features on a real estate product for a Saudi Arabian government client, inside a 20-developer mobile team.
Integrated third-party SDKs and embedded Unity into Flutter for an in-app metaverse where users explore buildings and events.

groups.title: Performance Team
bullets: Raised key screens from 30–40 FPS to a steady 60 by eliminating unnecessary re-renders.
Implemented SSL pinning, optimised data-layer caching, and migrated state management from Stream to BLoC.

groups.title: Cocototo – virtual pet game
bullets: A virtual pet game where players raise and care for a companion, taken from an empty repository to a released product.
Owned every layer: architecture, gameplay state, UI and release, reporting straight to the client across a time-zone gap.

groups.title: Pet Management App
groups.meta: SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose · Sole developer, both platforms
bullets: Built both native clients: iOS in SwiftUI, Android in Jetpack Compose — the same product built natively on each platform rather than through one cross-platform codebase.
Kept the domain model and screen flows consistent across two native stacks.

groups.title: Warehouse App for POS / Handheld Devices – sole developer
groups.meta: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Clean Architecture · Team size: 1 mobile dev
bullets: Sole developer, end to end, of a warehouse management app for Unitech HT300/HT330 barcode devices.
Integrated the hardware scanner for real-time barcode capture; handled goods receipt, dispatch and inventory updates over REST API.
Built an offline-first data layer that periodically fetched and persisted to an on-device database, so the floor kept working without a network.
Drove cross-team agreement on barcode formats; implemented auto-launch on reboot and published the app privately on Google Play.

groups.title: Cross-Platform Apps – Flutter & React Native
groups.meta: Flutter, React Native · Team size: 4–6 mobile devs
bullets: Built apps from scratch and maintained existing ones across booking, e-learning, file management and apartment equipment domains.
Led a sub-project with 3 members: planned sprints, estimated tasks and reviewed delivery.
Integrated VNPAY, FCM and Firebase Crashlytics.
